messages.content: 在C大調中，主要的三和弦是什麼？

function.name: music_analysis_find_common_chords
function.description: Find the most common chords in a specific genre of music. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: The genre of music to analyze.

num_chords.description: The number of top common chords to return.

message.content:
在 C 大調（C‑major）中，最常被視為「主三和弦」的三個和弦（即 I、IV、V）分別是：

| 和弦級 | 和弦名稱 | 音程組成 |
|--------|----------|----------|
| I      | C 大三和弦 (C‑E‑G) | 根音–大三度–純五度 |
| IV     | F 大三和弦 (F‑A‑C) | 根音–大三度–純五度 |
| V      | G 大三和弦 (G‑B‑D) | 根音–大三度–純五度 |

這三個和弦在 C 大調的調性結構中扮演核心角色，常用於建立調性、推進和解決。若你想了解更多關於其他級別（如 ii、iii、vi、vii°）或功能和弦（如屬和弦、半屬和弦）的資訊，隨時告訴我！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "在C大調中，主要的三和弦是什麼？" which translates to "In C major, what are the primary triads?" They want the primary chords in C major. In tonal theory, primary chords are I, IV, V. In C major, I = C major, IV = F major, V = G major. Also sometimes secondary dominant chords like ii, iii, vi, vii° are also triads. But primary triads are I, IV, V. So answer: C major, F major, G major. Provide explanation.
